## Details

<a id="bitmap"></a>
### [`bitmap`](../../../../src/graphics/background_bitmap.asm#L6) `$6000-$719F`

*data*

Multicolour bitmap of VIC bank 1: the background picture of the part 1 arena (8000 bytes). Part 2 has the throne room here. $917f draws the texts into it. $81bb draws the corner pictures at rows 2-5. $8d56 and $8d89 exchange rows 7-22, columns 4-35 with a second picture at $d000 when the scene changes.

- **Entry of:** [`bitmap_row_addr`](../../tables.md#bitmap_row_addr)

<a id="bitmap_arena_row14"></a>
### [`bitmap_arena_row14`](../../../../src/graphics/background_bitmap.asm#L485) `$71A0-$72DF`

*data*

Fighter area: bitmap cell rows 14-21, columns 4-35. $8aef saves it to $af50 at the start. Each frame, $8b5b copies the work bitmap at $a550 with both fighters into it.
Bitmap cell row 14, columns 4-35 (256 bytes): row 0 of the fighter area.

- **Read by:** [`save_fight_background`](../screen/fight_area.md#save_fight_background)
- **Written by:** [`show_work_bitmap`](../screen/fight_area.md#show_work_bitmap)
